findings.reason: The permanent alt-quality ManaRegen buff is not a remnant pickup effect. Both local remnant_effect_+% and global RemnantEffect are applied to every buff of a GeneratesRemnants skill. Only local Interlude is needed to explain these three cached rows.
findings.proposed_scope: Exclude ManaRemnantsPlayer from those two scaling additions; retain generic BuffEffect and all actual remnant buff behavior.

remaining_after_fix.gemling-legionnaire-04: 14 INC from two item-skill motes remains intentionally above pinned output.
remaining_after_fix.gemling-legionnaire-05: 14 INC from two item-skill motes remains intentionally above pinned output.
remaining_after_fix.gemling-legionnaire-06: Arithmetic reconciles exactly with pinned output.

findings.reason: Clarity requires Persistent AND Buff. Summon has Persistent without Buff; command has neither; minion shield has Buff without Persistent. Pinned canGrantedEffectSupportActiveSkill checks each operand against the union of summon/minion types and therefore accepts the cross-effect combination. Native direct judgement rejects it.
findings.confidence_limit: Frozen eligibility/text supports keeping rejection. Actual game socket/activation validation is not available; do not broaden support eligibility just to supply missing 50 INC or mark Clarity globally effectless.

findings.reason: Game text says Skills you have which require that Attribute, not only socketed Skill Gems. Firebolt and Mirror of Refraction each require Intelligence alone and contribute two motes, seven INC each. Pinned skips fromItem skills. Native keeps each once; existing maintainer-guide paragraph already adopts this interpretation.

Enabled Melting Maelstrom retains effect when mana fills. Native utility already computes 310/(3*(1+200/100))=310/9, exactly the pinned ManaRecovery; raw regen agrees. Reuse retained native per-second recovery under enabled-flask policy; no trigger/event history or estimated flask use rate is needed.
findings.ownership: Parent recovery integration; do not edit recovery.rs/survivability.rs/session detail files here.

proposal.proposed_owner: This research child, after parent confirms these three disjoint files; otherwise parent can apply the attached two production hunks.

regression_spec.setup: Synthetic build with Spark selected, Advanced Thaumaturgy node 14429, ManaRemnantsPlayer quality 20; inspect source-attributed ManaRegen and final regen.
regression_spec.positive_control: IntoTheBreachPlayer at level 1, one explicitly configured Purple Flame, Interlude III (+40%) plus 60% global RemnantEffect yields trunc(7*(1+1.0))=14 DamageGainAsChaos per flame; preserve real remnant buff scaling and source. Generic BuffEffect must still scale ManaRegen.

proposal.not_needed: No parser/stat rule changes, no regen, no docs/known registry edits; parent owns batch gate.
